maddeler.e:
تلاحمت (form VI)
# تَلَاحَمْتُ (talāḥamtu) /ta.laː.ħam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# تَلَاحَمْتَ (talāḥamta) /ta.laː.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# تَلَاحَمْتِ (talāḥamti) /ta.laː.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاحَمَ (talāḥama)
# تَلَاحَمَتْ (talāḥamat) /ta.laː.ħa.mat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
